proteins.name: Protein: SARS-CoV-2 Spike Glycoprotein WT (S)
proteins.definition: Homotrimeric class I fusion protein. S1 binds ACE2 via RBD; S2 mediates membrane fusion. Furin cleavage site unique to SARS-CoV-2. pI=6.24 places it near neutral at physiological pH.

proteins.name: Protein: SARS-CoV-2 Spike RBD (S1 Receptor Binding Domain)
proteins.definition: Twisted five-stranded antiparallel beta-sheet core. Directly contacts ACE2 Lys31 and Lys353. pI=8.91 (basic); 26 kDa. 15 key contact residues with ACE2.

proteins.name: Protein: SARS-CoV-2 Nucleocapsid Protein (N)
proteins.definition: RNA-binding phosphoprotein. Highly basic pI=10.07. Primary diagnostic antigen. Forms dimers and higher-order oligomers. Not a vaccine target due to intracellular location.

proteins.name: Protein: SARS-CoV-2 Membrane Protein (M)
proteins.definition: Most abundant structural protein. Three transmembrane domains. Hydrophobic GRAVY=0.446. Drives viral assembly and budding. pI=9.51 (basic).

proteins.name: Protein: SARS-CoV-2 Envelope Protein (E)
proteins.definition: Smallest structural protein. Viroporin (ion channel). Extremely hydrophobic GRAVY=1.128. Single transmembrane domain. pI=8.57. Critical for viral pathogenesis.

proteins.name: Protein: Influenza A Hemagglutinin H3N2 (HA)
proteins.definition: Class I fusion protein. Binds sialic acid alpha-2,6 linkages. pH 5.0-5.5 triggers irreversible conformational change to post-fusion state. Metastable prefusion trimer. pI=5.8.

proteins.name: Protein: HIV-1 Envelope Glycoprotein gp120
proteins.definition: Heavily glycosylated; 50% mass is N-linked carbohydrate. Binds CD4 then CCR5/CXCR4. Conformational masking shields conserved epitopes. pI=8.3. 5 variable loops (V1-V5).

proteins.name: Protein: Human ACE2 Receptor (hACE2)
proteins.definition: Zinc metalloprotease. SARS-CoV-2 entry receptor. Expressed in lung type II pneumocytes, heart, kidney, gut. pI=5.35 (acidic). Cleaves angiotensin II. 805 amino acids.

proteins.name: Protein: Neutralizing Antibody CR3022 (anti-SARS RBD)
proteins.definition: IgG1 antibody isolated from SARS-CoV-1 convalescent patient. Cross-reactive with SARS-CoV-2 RBD cryptic epitope. Kd=6.3 nM. PDB:6W41. Partial neutralization only.

proteins.name: Protein: Neutralizing Antibody S309 (Sotrovimab precursor)
proteins.definition: Broadly neutralizing IgG1. Binds SARS-CoV-2 RBD at conserved N-glycan site. Kd=0.6 nM. Basis for Sotrovimab therapeutic. Retains partial activity vs Omicron (IC50=8.2 nM).

proteins.name: Protein: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron BA.1 Spike (Variant of Concern)
proteins.definition: 32 spike mutations vs WT; 15 in RBD. Enhanced ACE2 affinity. Significant immune escape from prior immunity. Altered charge distribution: pI=6.31 vs WT 6.24. Lower hydrophobicity.

proteins.name: Protein: SARS-CoV-2 Delta B.1.617.2 Spike (Variant of Concern)
proteins.definition: 9 spike mutations vs WT; 2 in RBD (L452R, T478K). P681R at furin cleavage site enhances processing. Enhanced ACE2 affinity. pI=6.27. Increased transmissibility and severity.

interventions.name: Dexamethasone (corticosteroid)
interventions.evidence: 28% mortality reduction in severe COVID-19 (RECOVERY trial)

interventions.name: Baricitinib (JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor)
interventions.evidence: 38% mortality reduction in severe COVID-19 (COV-BARRIER trial)
